notes: tabularFigures is true when the Fontsource latin woff2 has a tnum GSUB feature or gives all ten digits one advance width (checked with fontTools). It describes the file Fontsource ships.
xHeight is an editorial judgement, not a measurement.
axes lists the main axes from api.fontsource.org/v1/variable/<id>. The default latin-wght file carries wght only; load other axes from the package axis files.
variable is false for families with only static files; package is then @fontsource/<id>.

sans.description: Workhorse faces for UI, body text and headings.
sans.fallback: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

serif.fallback: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif

display.description: High-impact faces for headlines and heroes. Large sizes only.

mono.description: Fixed-width faces for code blocks, technical UI and developer docs.
mono.fallback: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace

handwriting.description: Accent faces for personality. Short text only, used sparingly.

slab.description: Sturdy faces that bridge serif and display.
